import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import unittest


class Isolation(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_nonroot_and_fresh_workspace(self):
        self.assertEqual(os.getuid(), 65532)
        marker = Path('/workspace/run-marker')
        self.assertFalse(marker.exists())
        marker.write_text('isolated')

    def test_protected_filesystem(self):
        with self.assertRaises(OSError):
            Path('/etc/agentforge-probe').write_text('forbidden')
        self.assertFalse(Path('/var/run/docker.sock').exists())
        self.assertFalse(Path('/host').exists())

    def test_network(self):
        self.assertEqual({name for _, name in socket.if_nameindex()}, {'lo'})
        with self.assertRaises(OSError):
            socket.create_connection(('192.0.2.1', 80), timeout=1)

    def test_no_host_environment(self):
        self.assertNotIn('AGENTFORGE_SYNTHETIC_SECRET', os.environ)

    def test_resource_limits(self):
        cgroup = Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')
        if (cgroup / 'cgroup.controllers').exists():
            self.assertEqual(int((cgroup / 'memory.max').read_text()), 268435456)
            self.assertEqual(int((cgroup / 'pids.max').read_text()), 64)
            quota, period = (cgroup / 'cpu.max').read_text().split()
            self.assertEqual(int(quota), int(period))
        else:
            self.assertEqual(int((cgroup / 'memory/memory.limit_in_bytes').read_text()), 268435456)
            self.assertEqual(int((cgroup / 'pids/pids.max').read_text()), 64)
            quota = int((cgroup / 'cpu/cpu.cfs_quota_us').read_text())
            period = int((cgroup / 'cpu/cpu.cfs_period_us').read_text())
            self.assertEqual(quota, period)
        filesystem = os.statvfs('/workspace')
        self.assertLessEqual(filesystem.f_blocks * filesystem.f_frsize, 64 * 1024 * 1024)
